item.title: Wolverine Fuels acquires Bronco Utah Operations
item.description: EMERY — On Feb. 17, 2026, Wolverine Fuels LLC completed the purchase of coal assets from Bronco Coal Resources. The Emery Valley Mine will reopen under Emery Valley Resources, a subsidiary of Wolverine Fuels. Because of the inability to secure coal sale contracts, Bronco Mine experienced mass layoffs and ultimately halted operations on Dec. 2, 2025.
